coverage_detail_limits.81: Selecting the keyed fuel-use answer is an application of economical-driving advice to use the specified tyre pressure. The book does not explicitly derive the rolling-resistance mechanism.
coverage_detail_limits.87: Selecting appropriate speed and smooth driving uses the book’s noise/efficient-driving principles; no numerical acceleration/noise model is taught.
coverage_detail_limits.151: The book teaches the stabilising/skid-risk function and limits of stability control, which selects the correct option. Individual-wheel braking is additional keyed-answer detail not explicitly described in the book.
coverage_detail_limits.175: General warning/fault response and actual handbook instructions select the safe answer; the book does not teach a specific oil-pressure diagnostic or repair sequence.
